description: This file defines the Timer class, including its constructor, destructor, and methods for arming and canceling timers. It also defines the TimerException class for error handling related to timers, and the TimerMessage class for internal message passing within the timer implementation. The file is part of a library that provides millisecond timers based on pthreads, with support for callback functions and message-based control.

classes.name: TimerException
classes.description: Exception class for timer-related errors, derived from std::exception, holding an error message.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class representing a millisecond timer based on pthreads, supporting arming, canceling, and callback invocation.

classes.name: Timer::TimerMessage
classes.description: Internal message class used for controlling the timer thread, supporting message types like ARM, CANCEL, and QUIT.

methods.name: Timer::Timer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timer with a callback, user data, and a name.

methods.name: Timer::~Timer
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up timer resources.

methods.name: Timer::cancel
methods.description: Cancels any active timer, preventing the callback from being called.

methods.name: Timer::arm
methods.description: Arms the timer to trigger after a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createArmMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to arm the timer with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createCancelMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to cancel the timer.

methods.name: Timer::TimerMessage::createQuitMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to signal the timer thread to quit.

methods.name: Timer::timerThreadFunction
methods.description: Static function run by the timer thread to process messages and trigger callbacks.

methods.name: Timer::timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread, processing message queue and managing timer state.

methods.name: Timer::postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue, optionally with urgency.
